name: dev.ucp.common.loyalty
title: Loyalty Extension
description: Extends various Capabilities with loyalty support using memberships info.

reward_amount.description: Non-negative integer amount denominated in the minor unit of the associated reward currency. The associated reward currency's `decimal_places` defines the minor-to-major ratio and defaults to 0 when omitted.

earning_breakdown.description: Breakdown rule of the reward earnings

description.description: A display-ready, human-readable rationale for the specific rewards (e.g. 2x on footwear).

benefit_id.description: Optional `id` of the membership_tier_benefit that produced this rewards rule. Resolves against `membership_tier_benefit.id` within the same parent loyalty membership.

earning_forecast.description: Preview of rewards to be earned from the current transaction.

amount.description: Total rewards to be earned if the transaction completes.

breakdown.description: List of breakdown of earning contributing to the total.

reward_currency.description: The currency of the loyalty reward.

decimal_places.description: The position of a digit to the right of a decimal point. Applies to all amount related fields for rewards.

expiring_balance_tranche.description: Portion of a reward balance expiring on a specific timestamp.

amount.description: Amount of the reward balance expiring at `expires_at`, denominated in the minor unit of the associated reward currency.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this balance tranche expires.

reward_balance.description: Current redeemable balance and optional expiration schedule for a reward currency.

amount.description: Total current redeemable balance denominated in the minor unit of the associated reward currency.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp when the entire balance expires, if all units share a single expiration date.

expiring_tranches.description: Optional breakdown when subsets of the redeemable balance expire on different dates.

membership_reward.description: Quantifiable reward type, optional current balance, and optional earning forecast for the current transaction.

currency.description: A unit of value that customers can accumulate through various commercial activities.

balance.description: Current redeemable balance and optional expiration schedule for this reward currency.

earning_forecast.description: Preview of rewards to be earned from the current transaction.

available_credit.description: Non-point loyalty credit or award certificate held by the member.

id.description: Unique identifier for the credit or award certificate.

name.description: Human-readable name of the credit or award certificate (e.g. '$300 Annual Travel Credit', 'Free Night Award').

type.description: Category of the available credit. Well-known values: `monetary_credit` (fiat travel, statement, or flight credit denominated in minor units of `currency`), `certificate` (non-point award voucher or certificate such as a Free Night Award). Clients MUST tolerate and ignore unknown values.

remaining_amount.description: Remaining usable value. For `monetary_credit`, denominated in minor units of ISO 4217 `currency`. For `certificate`, remaining count of certificates.

total_amount.description: Original issued value in minor units of `currency` (for `monetary_credit`) or initial certificate count (for `certificate`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. 'USD'). Applicable when `type` is `monetary_credit`.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this credit or certificate expires.

description.description: Display-ready explanation of eligibility, property category caps, or redemption terms.

tier_progress_metric.description: Single qualification metric tracking progress toward a target loyalty tier.

metric_type.description: Qualification metric category. Well-known values: `nights`, `stays`, `spend`, `qualifying_points`, `qualifying_miles`, `segments`, `transactions`. Clients MUST tolerate and ignore unknown values.

unit.description: Unit code or label for the metric (e.g. 'NIGHTS', 'STAYS', 'USD', 'PQP', 'LP'). When `metric_type` is `spend` and `unit` is an ISO 4217 currency code, amounts are denominated in minor units of that currency.

current_amount.description: Member's current accumulated progress toward `target_amount` in the active qualification period.

target_amount.description: Total threshold required on this metric to achieve the target tier.

description.description: Display-ready summary of progress on this metric (e.g. '12 nights needed for Globalist').

tier_progress.description: Progress tracking toward a higher loyalty membership tier.

target_tier_id.description: Identifier of the next tier being tracked.

target_tier_name.description: Human-readable name of the target tier (e.g. 'Globalist', 'Platinum Pro').

qualification_operator.description: How multiple `metrics` combine to satisfy tier qualification. Well-known values: `any` (qualify by meeting any single metric, such as nights OR points), `all` (qualify by meeting all listed metrics, such as nights AND spend). Defaults to `any` when omitted. Clients MUST tolerate and ignore unknown values.

qualification_period_ends_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the current qualification tracking period ends.

linked_program.description: Partner or transfer loyalty program linked to this membership.

program_key.description: Reverse-domain identifier of the linked partner or transfer loyalty program (e.g. 'com.example.airlines.rewards').

name.description: Human-readable name of the linked loyalty program (e.g. 'Example Airlines Rewards').

display_id.description: Masked or partial member identifier in the linked program (e.g. '****9012').

membership_tier_benefit.description: Benefits associated with a membership tier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tier benefit.

type.description: Optional machine-readable benefit category for UI badges and filtering. Well-known values: `room_discount`, `free_breakfast`, `late_checkout`, `room_upgrade`, `free_wifi`, `free_checked_bag`, `priority_boarding`, `lounge_access`, `free_shipping`. Clients MUST tolerate and ignore unknown values.

description.description: A display-ready, human-readable explanation of this benefit (e.g. 'Early access to sales').

membership_tier.description: Specific achievement rank or status milestone that unlocks escalating value as a member progresses through activity or spend.

id.description: Unique identifier for the membership tier.

name.description: The human-readable name of the tier (e.g., 'Platinum').

benefits.description: List of benefits associated with this tier.

loyalty_membership.description: Loyalty membership the business has accepted for the eligibility claim represented by the parent map key. Programs that can be joined independently MUST be modeled as separate sibling entries under the loyalty map, distinguished by reverse-domain naming (e.g., 'com.example.rewards' and 'com.example.rewards.card').

name.description: Business specific name of the loyalty membership/program.

display_id.description: A masked or partial version of the membership id for user recognition (e.g., '****5678'). MUST NOT be set if the membership has not been verified.

tiers.description: Active or display-safe tier context for this membership. Most programs are single-status (one entry); programs with parallel status dimensions (e.g., current and lifetime) populate one entry per active tier. Omitted when no tier context has been resolved.

tier_progress.description: Progress tracking toward one or more higher membership tiers.

rewards.description: Reward types, current balances, and earning forecasts associated with this membership. Each object encapsulates one type of reward.

credits.description: Non-point loyalty credits and award certificates available on this membership.

linked_programs.description: Partner or transfer loyalty programs linked to this membership.

provisional.description: True if this membership requires additional verification.

loyalty.description: Key-value map whose keys represent buyer/platform asserted eligibility claims and whose values represent associated membership information. All loyalty keys MUST use reverse-domain naming to ensure provenance and prevent collisions when multiple extensions contribute to the shared namespace.

propertyNames.description: Reverse-domain identifier that represents eligibility claim accepted by the Business for this membership.

additionalProperties.description: Payload that describes the membership information corresponding to the claim.
